profile.name: 通用UDP组播通信接口
profile.description: 一种基于 IP/UDP 组播的虚拟通信接口，用于在实验室中的多台计算机、多个进程或分布式控制节点之间广播和接收数据。它常用于网络化消息分发、虚拟 CAN 通信测试、系统联调以及局域网内的多节点数据交换。
profile.description_en: A virtual communication interface based on IP/UDP multicast for broadcasting and receiving data among multiple laboratory computers, processes, or distributed control nodes. It is commonly used for network message distribution, virtual CAN communication tests, system integration, and multi-node data exchange on a local area network.

registry.name: Open Standard General Purpose UDP Multicast Bus
registry.description: General Purpose UDP Multicast BUS是由Open Standard生产的实验执行&合成设备。支持Signal, Slot, fileno等操作。
